newsitem.title: CHINA: China PC sales to top eight million by 2000.
newsitem.headline: China PC sales to top eight million by 2000.

text.p: Annual sales of personal computers (PCs) in China will reach eight to 10 million units by the year 2000, the Xinhua new agency quoted a Ministry of Electronics Industry researcher as saying.
Turnover in China's computer and related industries soared to 92 billion yuan ($11 billion) last year, up nearly 50 percent compared with 1995, Xinhua said in a report late on Thursday.
Hardware sales rocketed 52 percent to 71.5 billion yuan, it quoted Zhou Muchang, head of the Ministry's Computer and Microelectronics Research Centre, as saying.
Software sales rose 35.3 percent to 9.2 billion yuan and information services sales hit 11.3 billion yuan, up nearly 47 percent, Zhou said.
Official estimates put personal computer sales at 1.8 million in 1996.
